newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: J.P.Morgan launches Portugal govt bond index.
newsitem.headline: J.P.Morgan launches Portugal govt bond index.

text.p: J.P.Morgan said it had launched a Portuguese government bond index, incorporating only issues that are regularly traded and available for investment.

It said in a statement that Banco Espirito Santo, one of the major market makers and primary dealers in Portuguese government bonds, was the local partner in Lisbon and provided historical data, daily prices and information regarding market rules used to construct the index.

The statement said the launch of the index was justified by the growing interest in the Portuguese debt market by foreign investors, because of the strong performance of the Portuguese economy as it took steps to prepare to join a single European currency.
The Portuguese Bond Index is available on a daily basis starting on December 30, 1994 and includes only fixed rate OTs (bonds) deemed liquid by J.P.Morgan, working with BES, it said.
